TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD288B INSTALLED WI 1.89NM RADIUS OF
521950N 0001148W (HUNTINGDON, CAMBRIDGESHIRE). BEYOND VISUAL LINE
OF SIGHT (BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT
400FT AGL. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN
ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC
CAT VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA
WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD
FLIGHT, FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS
MUST BE OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY
UNDER CAP 722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG
RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR CREWED ACCESS 01223 823551 OR
PORTAL.AIRSENTRY.UK. FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. AR-2026-9359/02.
